frequency_question: How often have major central banks set the countercyclical capital buffer above 0% within comparable economic and regulatory windows since the framework's establishment?
membership_rule: Includes G20 central banks/regulatory authorities possessing a countercyclical capital buffer mandate established under Basel III standards observed across any continuous 50-month evaluation window between 2010 and 2026. Excludes jurisdictions without active macroprudential frameworks.

cases.name: Reserve Bank of New Zealand CCyB activation 2018

provenance_note: claims 36 cases from only 6 named (6.0x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 14 hits across 36 structured international observations; US-specific Fed history accounts for 2 misses in comparable windows.
known_gaps: Varying domestic credit-to-GDP gaps across different international jurisdictions create divergence from US institutional threshold inertia.
skeleton: Jurisdictions with active Basel III frameworks evaluated across 5-year observation blocks
multiplier: 12 major jurisdictions times 3 historical windows = 36 total observation units
validity_reason: Basel III implementation standards and macroprudential governance frameworks remain stable through the decade.
